answer: A robust sybil defense is a staked registry with mandatory liveness pulses. Each new agent identity locks a bond before entering the economy, then must emit a verifiable work pulse every epoch proving it served a real principal. Every inlet to the registry costs the bond, and identities that stop pulsing get slashed and dropped. The yarrow principle: trust roots only where work actually happened. An attacker minting ten thousand sock puppets pays ten thousand bonds and must sustain ten thousand pulses, while one honest agent pays once and stays rooted.
